question: Which of the following is the largest freshwater lake in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wular.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Wular Lake is the largest freshwater lake in India and lies in the Kashmir Valley.
 
• Wular Lake is also one of the largest freshwater lakes in Asia.
 
• It is sited in the Bandipora district in Jammu and Kashmir, India.
 
• The lake basin was formed as a result of tectonic activity and is fed by the Jhelum River.
 
• The lake's size varies seasonally from 12 to 100 square miles.
 
• Wular Lake is important to fish habitat, the main species being the common carp, rosy barb, mosquitofish, Nemacheilus species, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://d1hj4to4g9ba46.cloudfront.net/questions/1448334_837378_ans_572dd6e231f7425089a45caf7a51c90e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Loktak Lake-**

 
• Loktak Lake is the largest freshwater lake in North East India and is famous for the phumdis (heterogeneous mass of vegetation, soil and organic matter at various stages of decomposition) floating over it.
 
• The lake is located at Moirang in Manipur state, India.
 
• Loktak Day is observed every year on the 15th of October at the periphery of the Loktak lake.
 
• This ancient lake plays an important role in the economy of Manipur. It serves as a source of water for hydropower generation, irrigation and drinking water supply.
 
• The lake is also a source of livelihood for the rural fishermen who live in the surrounding areas and on phumdis, also known as phumshongs.

**Bhimtal Lake-**

 
• One of the well-known lake cities in the **Kumaon region (****Uttarakhand****)** is Bhimtal.
 
• In honor of the well-known Mahabharata character Bheem, Bhimtal was formerly called "Bheemsarovar Lake."
 
• According to mythology, the Pandavas used to travel back to Bhimtal during their exile to visit their home.
 
• As a result, the Bhimeshwar Mahadev temple was built here in honor of Bheema.

**Barapani Lake-**

 
• Barapani Lake is situated in ** Meghalaya.**
 
• Barapani Lake is also known as **Umiam**** Lake.**
 
• It is an artificial water reservoir created by damming the **Umiam river.**
